map.title: MAP 1 · MONUMENT
map.intro: Dummy Corporation welcomes you off the factory floor. The cars are your colleagues; the red one learns. Certification is your goal.

tiles.title: The welcome wall
tiles.newIdea: Walkin on open road: let it hit you. Earns the car its forward camera.
tiles.tale: Fresh off the factory floor. Your first colleague is red, keen and blind. Walk out and meet it.
tiles.hint: Open road: walk into its path; let it hit you.

tiles.title: The podium bridge
tiles.newIdea: Kerbstep: hide at the kerb, step into its path. Earns Battery 1.
tiles.tale: The podium bridge was built for shoppers who never came. Our colleague brakes now; hide at the kerb.
tiles.hint: Hide behind the kiosk at the kerb; step into its path late.

tiles.title: The LED drum
tiles.newIdea: Dashcover: Space dash from set-back cover into its path. Earns side sensors.
tiles.tale: The LED drum lights each bend. Battery 1 is fitted; the cover stands too far back to walk.
tiles.hint: Wait behind the set-back cabinet; dash, Space, into its path.

tiles.title: The portal tower
tiles.newIdea: Drop: walk off the roof plaza's parapet gap into its path. Earns Hands 1.
tiles.tale: The road runs through the portal tower. Up on the plaza you are off its map; gravity is policy.
tiles.hint: Escalator up; drop through the parapet gap into its path.

tiles.title: The monument
tiles.newIdea: Conebait: cone in its lane, stand where it swerves. Earns Legs 1.
tiles.tale: The plaque reads ZERO ACCIDENTS: a target, not a record. Hands 1 is fitted; colleagues swerve for cones.
tiles.hint: Hold J to cone its lane; stand in its swerve path.

tiles.title: The neon shops
tiles.newIdea: Jumprail: run, L jump the K-rail into its path. Earns the roof lidar.
tiles.tale: The neon shops sell nothing, but the traffic reads them. Legs 1 is fitted; the K-rail is policy.
tiles.hint: From the kiosk, run at the K-rail; L jump into its path.

tiles.title: The stacked cubes
tiles.newIdea: Blindspot: Space dash from cover into its path. Earns Super Knees.
tiles.tale: The stacked cubes rose one budget at a time. Street cameras are coming; learn which cover they will miss.
tiles.hint: Wait behind the kiosk; Space dash into its path ahead.

tiles.title: The LED canyon
tiles.newIdea: Duckdash: hold C behind a planter, Space dash into its path. Earns street cameras.
tiles.tale: Two screens advertise to each other all night. Super Knees is fitted: hold C and the planter hides you.
tiles.hint: Hold C behind the planter; dash, Space, into its path.

tiles.title: The LED gateway
tiles.newIdea: Blindspot under the cameras: dash from the hedge they miss. Earns road items.
tiles.tale: The LED gateway thanks each colleague for driving safely. Exit written off; your Certification continues next district.
tiles.hint: Dash from the hedge out of camera sight, into its path.

rationale: Chain unchanged: stages follow the car's rung, and each earned part feeds the next trick. Counts drop to 1 where the stage's measured ways don't list the trick; only the dashcover tile keeps 2. The finale now plays blindspot on the watched level, so it isn't a repeat of duckdash. Tales and hints are reworded to vary structure and keep the fault wording.
